layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Abstract

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Semantic segmentation is a crucial prerequisite in clinical

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: applications and computer-aided diagnosis. With the devel-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: opment of deep neural networks, biomedical image segmen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tation has achieved remarkable success. Encoder-decoder

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: architectures that integrate convolutions and transformers

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: are gaining attention for their potential to capture both

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: global and local features. However, current designs face

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the contradiction that these two features cannot be contin-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: uously transmitted. In addition, some models lack a uni-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fied and standardized evaluation benchmark, leading to sig-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: nificant discrepancies in the experimental setup. In this

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: study, we review and summarize these architectures and an-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: alyze their contradictions in design. We modify UNet and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: propose WNet to combine transformers and convolutions,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: addressing the transmission issue effectively. WNet cap-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tures long-range dependencies and local details simulta-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: neously while ensuring their continuous transmission and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: multi-scale fusion. We integrate WNet into the nnUNet

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: framework for unified benchmarking. Our model achieves

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: state-of-the-art performance in biomedical image segmen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tation. Extensive experiments demonstrate their effective-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ness on four 2D datasets (DRIVE, ISIC-2017, Kvasir-SEG,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and CREMI) and four 3D datasets (Parse2022, AMOS22,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: BTCV, and ImageCAS). The code is available at https :

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: //github.com/Yanfeng-Zhou/nnWNet.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 1. Introduction

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Segmentation is a fundamental task in biomedical image

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: analysis, where the goal is to assign a class label to each

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pixel (voxel). With the development of deep learning,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: biomedical image segmentation has achieved superior re-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sults [16, 23, 25, 33, 41, 58, 60–62]. Convolutional neural

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: networks (CNNs) based on the encoder-decoder architec-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ture are a mainstream paradigm [25, 41]. Two key charac-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: teristics of CNNs are local connections and parameter shar-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing. Local connections ensure that the extracted features are

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: specific to the local input, while parameter sharing makes

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the features translationally invariant. This design enhances

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: computational efficiency while enabling CNNs to focus on

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: local details.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Recently, the sequence-to-sequence transformer archi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tecture has gained significant attention [11, 34, 47]. It

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: utilizes a global self-attention mechanism to capture long-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: range dependencies and global information. However, it

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: also brings the limitations of high computational overhead

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and a tendency to overlook local details.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Some studies have attempted to combine convolutions

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and transformers to leverage both local and global recep-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tive fields simultaneously. These combination strategies in-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: clude: alternately stacking convolutional layers and trans-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: former layers [3, 14, 29], using convolution (Conv) to build

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the encoder and transformer (Trans) to build the decoder

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (or vice versa) [17, 18], and incorporating transformers into

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: bottleneck blocks or bridge blocks between the encoder and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: However, these designs are contradictory and flawed.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The purpose of the transformer layer is to extract long-range

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dependencies and generate corresponding global features,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: while the convolutional layer is to capture local details and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: generate locally-focused features. The current combination

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: method forces the transformer layer to use local features

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: as input to extract global features, and enforces the convo-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: lutional layer to operate on global features to extract local

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: details. Global features and local features are generated al-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ternately and cannot be transmitted continuously and stably

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: throughout the model. This contradiction leads to feature

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: confusion and instability of the training process.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In addition, the current biomedical image segmentation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: models lack a unified evaluation benchmark [26]. Differ-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ent studies have significant discrepancies in experimental

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: datasets, image preprocessing strategies (such as resam-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pling, region of interest cropping), training and validation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: set divisions, evaluation metrics, and some key hyperparam-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: eters (such as patch size, loss function, and number of train-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing epochs). This lack of standardization makes it challeng-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing to compare results across studies and evaluate the true

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: performance of different models. Some models may excel

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: in specific datasets, but fail to generalize in others. More-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: over, certain models that claim state-of-the-art performance

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: may not perform well under a unified benchmark and even

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: worse than a well-designed UNet.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In this study, we review various biomedical image seg-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mentation models based on convolutions and transformers,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: abstracting them into several typical architectures and ana-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: lyzing the contradictions and defects within these designs.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: To effectively incorporate transformers into the fully con-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: volutional UNet [41] for extracting global features while

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: addressing these issues, we propose a modified architec-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ture, WNet. WNet captures both long-range dependen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cies and local details, ensuring continuous transmission of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: these two types of features without alternation or confu-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sion. We then integrate WNet into the automatically config-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ured framework, nnUNet [25], resulting in nnWNet. Exten-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sive experiments on a unified evaluation benchmark based

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: on the nnUNet framework demonstrate its effectiveness.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Our model achieves state-of-the-art performance on four 2D

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: datasets and four 3D datasets with different segmentation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: objects, data scales, and image modalities.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Our contributions are summarized as follows:

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: • We systematically summarize and classify various

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: biomedical image segmentation models based on convo-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: lutions and transformers, and analyze their contradictions

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and defects.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: • We slightly adjust the UNet architecture and propose

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: WNet. WNet focuses on both long-range dependencies

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and local details, ensuring continuous transmission of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: these two types of features without alternation or confu-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sion throughout the network.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: • We integrate WNet into the nnUNet framework, result-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing in nnWNet. nnWNet achieves state-of-the-art perfor-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mance on four 2D datasets and four 3D datasets within a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: unified evaluation benchmark.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2. Related Work

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Convolution-Based Biomedical Image Segmentation.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The efficient and lightweight U-shaped CNNs are dominant

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: in biomedical image segmentation. They can retain the po-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sition information of the boundaries and alleviate overfitting

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: under the limited data volume of biomedical images. Some

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: studies add or improve various designs to the U-shaped

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: CNNs to better extract features. UNet++ [62] redesigns the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: skip connection between the encoder and decoder to achieve

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: multi-scale feature aggregation. Attention UNet [37] inte-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: grates the attention gate module into UNet [41] to better

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: focus on target structures of varying shapes and sizes. [45]

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: proposes a full convolutional U-shaped network (CMUNet)

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: that incorporates hybrid convolution and multi-scale atten-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion gate. Furthermore, some studies have extended these

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: architectures to 3D to meet the needs of volumetric seg-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mentation. [36] proposes a fully convolutional 3D network,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: VNet. ConResNet [55] proposes inter-slice context residual

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: learning to improve the ability of spatial context perception.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: [57] proposes a low-frequency and high-frequency fusion

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: network, XNet, for fully- and semi-supervised biomedical

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: image segmentation.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Transformer-Based Biomedical Image Segmentation.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The transformer model treats images as sequences of small

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: patches. It employs a self-attention mechanism based on

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fully connected networks to capture long-range dependen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cies across the entire image and uses position encoding

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to represent the spatial relationships between the patches.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Several studies have explored integrating transformers into

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: U-shaped architectures. Common strategies include: pure

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: transformer UNet without convolutional layers, such as

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: SwinUNet [5], D-Former [12], nnFormer [56]; replac-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing the convolutional encoder or decoder with the trans-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: former, such as TC-CoNet [8], ConvTransSeg [13], UN-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ETR [18], Swin UNETR [17], 3D UX-Net [32]; incorpo-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: rating transformer-based bridges or bottlenecks between the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: encoder and decoder, such as CoTr [50], MissFormer [24],

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: DCA [1], TransAttUNet [6]; stacking convolutional lay-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ers and transformer layers in series or parallel, such as

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ConvFormer [14], H2Former [20], DuAT [46], MaxViT-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: UNet [29]. Furthermore, some studies are focused on op-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: timizing the self-attention mechanism to reduce compu-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tational costs and memory consumption, such as BRAU-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Net++ [30], UNETR++ [43]. However, these architectural

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: designs have the defect of alternating and confusing trans-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mission between global and local features. We discuss this

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: issue in more detail in Section 3.1.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: nnUNet. nnUNet [25, 26] is an automatically config-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ured segmentation framework that sets image preprocess-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing, data augmentation, and training hyperparameters. It

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: not only serves as an out-of-the-box segmentation solution

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: but also provides a unified benchmark for evaluating model

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: performance. In this study, we conduct a comprehensive

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and fair comparison based on the nnUNet framework.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 3. Method

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In Section 3.1, we review and summarize various encoder-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: decoder architectures and analyze the contradictions of cur-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: rent designs combining transformers and convolutions. In

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Section 3.2, we make slight adjustments to the fully con-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: volutional UNet to propose WNet, which integrates trans-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: formers and addresses the contradictions. In Section 3.3,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: we integrate WNet into the nnUNet framework for unified

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: benchmarking.

layout_dets.text: 3.1. Discussion on Encoder-Decoder Architectures

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: As shown in Figure 1, current encoder-decoder models can

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: be summarized and abstracted into three main architec-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tures: encoder-decoder, encoder-bottleneck-decoder, and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: encoder-bridge-decoder. These three architectures are com-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: posed of four modules: encoder, decoder, bottleneck, and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: bridge. These four modules can not only be the sequential

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: connection of pure convolutional layers or pure transformer

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: layers, but also the series or parallel connection of convolu-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tional layers and transformer layers. Table 2 lists these ar-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: chitectures along with some corresponding models. Convo-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: lution focuses on capturing local details, while transformer

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: emphasizes global relationships. Their combination has the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: potential to enhance the feature representation capability.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: However, current combination strategies are contradic-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tory. Whether using transformers as encoders and con-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: volutions as decoders (or vice versa), or stacking convo-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: lutional and transformer layers alternately, they force the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: transformer layers to utilize local features as input to cap-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ture long-range dependencies, and force the convolutional

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: layers to use global features as input for extracting local de-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tails. It disrupts the continuous and stable flow of global

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and local features throughout the model, leading to training

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 3.2. Integrating Transformers without Contradic-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tions

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: To integrate the transformer into the encoder-decoder archi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tecture, and ensure that global and local features can be con-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tinuously transmitted without interruption and confusion,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: we slightly adjust UNet [41] and propose WNet. Figure 2

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: shows an overview of WNet. WNet consists of two cas-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: caded encoder-decoder architectures, performs Overlapped

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Patch Embedding (OPE) on the input images, uses the Local

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Scope Blocks (LSBs) to construct multi-scale encoding and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: decoding layers, and introduces the Global Scope Bridges

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (GSBs) between the encoding and decoding layers at each

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: scale. We employ convolutional layers as LSBs to extract

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: local details, and use transformer layers as GSBs to capture

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: long-range dependencies. LSBs and GSBs perform feature

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fusion to exchange information at each encoding-decoding

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Specifically, the overlapped feature embedding is im-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: plemented by 3×3 convolutions with a stride of 1 and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: down-sampling. LSBs are implemented by 3×3 resid-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ual blocks [21] with a stride of 1 and down/up-sampling.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: GSBs are implemented by transformers with global atten-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion mechanism. Feature fusion is implemented by channel

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: concatenation. We compare various attention mechanisms

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and fusion strategies in ablation studies in Section 4.6. Note

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sitional relationships, and since LSBs and GSBs can ex-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: change information, we do not introduce additional posi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tional encoding in GSBs.

layout_dets.text: 3.3. Calling for a Unified Evaluation Benchmark

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Due to the diversity of biomedical images in terms of im-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: age sizes, dimensions, modalities, imaging regions, pixel

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (voxel) sizes, segmentation objects, data scales, and patho-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: logical changes, there are significant differences even

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: among datasets for the same clinical application. It results

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: in a lack of standardized training and validation set divi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sions and consistent evaluation metrics for evaluating per-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: formance. Some studies attempt to refine image prepro-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cessing (such as image resampling and region of interest

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cropping) and optimize key hyperparameters (such as patch

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: size and the number of training epochs) to ensure that their

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: models perform better.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In general, due to the lack of a unified evaluation bench-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mark, comparative experiments are no longer merely a com-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: petition of model architectures. nnUNet [25, 26] is an au-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tomatically configured segmentation framework. More im-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: portantly, it provides a unified benchmark for purely and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fairly comparing various architectures. We integrate WNet

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: into the nnUNet framework to standardize the experimental

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: setup.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 4.1. Datasets

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: We evaluate our model on four 2D datasets (DRIVE [44],

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ISIC-2017 [9], Kvasir-SEG [27], and CREMI [12]) and four

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 3D datasets (Parse2022 [35], AMOS22 [28], BTCV [31],

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ImageCAS [53]). Table 2 presents the details on their ex-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: perimental setup. Additional information on these eight

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: datasets is presented in the supplementary materials. From

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Table 2, these datasets cover different modalities, dimen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sions, imaging regions, data scales, and segmentation ob-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: jects. Evaluating model performance is more representative

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and convincing.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 4.2. Unified Evaluation Benchmark

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: We implement our model via nnUNet framework (version

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2.3.1). Training and inference of all the models are per-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: formed on one NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU. All models are

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: trained from scratch. To balance training time and effect,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: we use 2d and 3d_lowres trainer for 2D and 3D datasets,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: respectively. The number of training epochs is set to 200

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: for 2D datasets and 500 for 3D datasets. We use five-fold

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cross-validation to evaluate the segmentation results and use

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the Jaccard index (Jaccard), Dice coefficient (Dice), 95th-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: percentile Hausdorff distance (95HD), and average surface

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: distance (ASD) as performance metrics. Jaccard and Dice

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: emphasize pixel-wise accuracy, whereas 95HD and ASD

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: emphasize boundary accuracy. Furthermore, we only use

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the output of models to evaluate performance without any

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: additional post-processing. Other configurations (such as

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: learning rate, loss function, patch size, and optimizer) are

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the default in the nnUNet framework.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 4.6. Ablation Studies

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: To verify the effectiveness of each component, we perform

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the following ablation studies on four 2D datasets.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Comparison of Different Self-Attention. Table 5 com-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pares the performance of adding different self-attentions to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: GSBs, including depth-wise convolution (DW Conv) with

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: large kernel [32], pooling [52], and efficient multi-head self-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: attention (E-MHSA) [15]. Pooling achieves better results.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: We use pooling as self-attention to all relevant experiments

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: in Table 3.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Comparison of Fusion Strategies. Table 6 compares

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: different fusion strategies of global and local features. We

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: find that the channel concatenation used by the raw UNet

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: achieves better performance. We apply it to all relevant ex-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: periments in Table 3.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Effectiveness of Combining Convolution and Trans-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: former. We replace LSBs with PoolFormers and GSBs with

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: residual blocks to generate a pure transformer WNet and a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pure convolutional WNet, respectively. Table 7 compares

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the performance of hybrid, pure convolutional, and pure

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: transformer architectures. Overall, the hybrid architecture

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: demonstrates superior results. Note that the pure convolu-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tional architecture may achieve better contour accuracy be-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cause convolution focuses on local details and is sensitive

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to boundaries.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Necessity of Continuous Transmission of Global and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Local Features. We replace the encoder and decoder in the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: raw UNet [41] to demonstrate the significance of continu-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ous transmitting global and local features. Specifically, we

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: implement pure convolution, pure transformer, series con-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: nection of convolution and transformer, and parallel con-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: nection of convolution and transformer to construct the en-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: coder and decoder. Table 8 compares the performance of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: these architectures. Our findings indicate that the series

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: connection has a negative effect. This may be due to the se-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ries connection forcing global and local features to be gen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: erated alternately, which hinders continuous transmission.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In contrast, the parallel connection and fusion before each

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: down-sampling yields positive results because it avoids the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: conflict of capturing long-range dependencies from local

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: features while simultaneously extracting local details from

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: global features. The performance of using a convolutional

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: encoder with a transformer decoder is similar to that of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: using a transformer encoder with a convolutional decoder,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: with both architectures performing between the series and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: parallel connections. Furthermore, we find that the combi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: nation of transformer and convolution outperforms the pure

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: convolutional architecture, further proving the necessity of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: focusing on both global and local features.

layout_dets.text: 5. Conclusion

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: We systematically summarize the transformer-based

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: encoder-decoder architectures for biomedical image seg-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mentation and analyze the contradictions within their

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: designs. To incorporate the transformer and address the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: contradictions, we slightly adjust UNet and propose WNet.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: WNet can capture long-range dependencies and local

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: details simultaneously and ensure their continuous trans-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mission and multi-scale fusion. We integrate WNet into the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: nnUNet framework for unified benchmarking. Our model

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: achieves state-of-the-art biomedical image segmentation,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and extensive experiments on four 2D datasets and four 3D

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: datasets demonstrate its effectiveness.
